name: com.foldcanvas.core
description: A deterministic 2D-first Unity surface compiler with explicit topology, canonical FoldScript, bounded extensions, tiered validation, clean-install evidence, and replayable robustness gates.

samples.description: A minimal source asset demonstrating planar panel compilation and canvas UV preservation.
Eight authored 2D gore panels mapped and welded into one validated closed sphere without a sphere primitive.
Editor-generated 2D torus and handled-cup sources proving explicit cyclic seams, boundary spans, and closed topology.
A compiling contributor template for explicit per-compile position-operation registration without topology or UV mutation.
